lines.text: What if every person on Earth lost their *color vision*... for five seconds?
Five million *cones* in your eyes see color. Over ninety million *rods* see in the dark.
You'd expect black and white. It's *worse*.
Rods are built for the night. In daylight they're *overwhelmed*, and the world turns blinding.
Rods barely see red, so every red sign goes *dark*.
And the spot you're looking at? *Blank*. The very center of your eye has no rods at all.
About one in thirty thousand people live like this every day.
Follow for more. What should vanish next?
